Bird Other
Dataset structure for IC-LoRA training (adding birds):
• reference_video = empty sky clip (sky_empty role)
• video = same scene with birds added (bird_sky role)
• Pairs are created by running temporal median filtering on bird_sky clips to produce the empty-sky reference.
Note: These are source page URLs (Pexels/Pixabay/Mixkit), not direct video file links. Click to visit the source page and download. Pexels API clips include direct download links in the JSON.
